# Rule set 1 — write-good

The [`write-good`](https://github.com/btford/write-good) checks, which
`style.md` already names. Each finding needs a concrete rewrite, not just the
flag.

## passive

"was written by", "is generated by", "can be found". Name the actor: "the
generator writes", "you can find". Passive is fine when the actor is genuinely
unknown or irrelevant ("the post was published in 2021").

## illusion

A word repeated back to back — "the the", "to to". Always a bug.

## so

A sentence opening with "So,". Cut it.

## thereIs

A sentence opening with "There is" / "There are". Usually hides the real
subject: "There are three things that break" → "Three things break".

## weasel

Vague intensifiers and quantifiers that promise precision and don't deliver.
The full list from the `weasel-words` package:

> are a number, clearly, completely, exceedingly, excellent, extremely, fairly,
> few, huge, interestingly, is a number, largely, many, mostly, obviously,
> quite, relatively, remarkably, several, significantly, substantially,
> surprisingly, tiny, various, vast, very

Replace with the actual number, or delete. "too many" and "too few" are fine.

## adverb

`-ly` adverbs propping up a weak verb. "ran quickly" → "sprinted". Keep adverbs
that carry real information ("the build fails silently").

## tooWordy

Long phrases with a short equivalent. The `too-wordy` package ships ~250
entries; these are the ones that actually show up in technical writing:

> a number of, additional, adjacent to, aforementioned, as per, at this time,
> because of the fact that, commence, comply with, consequently, demonstrate,
> due to the fact that, during the course of, each and every, eliminate,
> employ, facilitate, first and foremost, for the purpose of, however,
> implement, in a timely manner, in addition, in an effort to, in excess of,
> in order to, in terms of, in the event that, in the process of, indicate,
> initiate, it is essential, majority of, methodology, minimize, modify,
> multiple, myriad of, necessitate, nevertheless, numerous, obtain, on the
> other hand, overall, prior to, prioritize, provided that, regarding, retain,
> shall, similar to, subsequent, substantial, sufficient, terminate, therefore,
> time period, type of, until such time as, utilize, validate, whether or not,
> with respect to

Prefer the plain word: use not utilize, before not prior to, to not in order
to, change not modify, but not however.

## cliches

The stock phrase that arrives pre-assembled — "at the end of the day",
"low-hanging fruit", "moving the needle", "best of both worlds", "tip of the
iceberg". The `no-cliches` package lists 723 of them; the test is simpler than
the list. If you've read the phrase a hundred times, say the thing directly.

## Long sentences

Over ~35 words, or three or more clauses stacked with commas and "and". Split
it.
